description.fun: Sneasel is smart, sneaky and notoriously vicious: it raids nests for Eggs, pokes a hole with a claw and slurps out the contents, and pairs team up, one luring the parents away while the other steals, before squabbling over the loot. Breeders despise it. It's part cat and part kamaitachi, the sickle-clawed weasel of Japanese legend, and its name blends sneaky and weasel.
description.guide: A Dark- and Ice-type Pokémon resembling a cat and a weasel, with sharp retractable claws, known for ambushing prey and stealing Eggs. It evolves into Weavile when levelled up at night holding a Razor Claw. Its Fighting- and Poison-type Hisuian form evolves into Sneasler.
description.tagline: A sneaky ice weasel that steals Eggs straight from the nest

description.fun: Hisuian Sneasel climbs sheer cliffs on curved claws tipped with a venom that attacks the nervous system, and it's Fighting and Poison instead of Dark and Ice. It lacks the spite of Johto's Sneasel, perhaps because of its harsher surroundings, and it evolves into Sneasler instead of Weavile.

Weavile hunts in packs of four or five with a leader, bringing down prey as big as Mamoswine and sharing it out, and a scratch from its claws can cause frostbite. Packs talk by carving signs into trees, ice and boulders, with over 500 recorded. Even asleep it's crafty: it's been seen gesturing in its sleep, perhaps so nobody can tell it's dozing.
description.guide: A Dark- and Ice-type Pokémon introduced in Generation 4, the evolution of Sneasel, with a crown and collar of red feathers. It lives in snowy areas and hunts in packs, communicating by carving signs. Sneasel evolves into it when levelled up at night holding a Razor Claw.
description.tagline: A cunning pack hunter that carves secret signs in the ice

description.fun: Sneasler is what Hisuian Sneasel became after adapting to the cliffs of Hisui's frozen highlands: a lanky climber with poison-tipped claws, so strong that nothing in its habitat could beat it. Unlike Weavile, it prefers to live alone. A special Sneasler, descended from one of the ancient Pokémon blessed by Arceus, serves as a Ride Pokémon in the Coronet Highlands in Legends: Arceus.
description.guide: A Fighting- and Poison-type Pokémon from Legends: Arceus, the evolution of Hisuian Sneasel. It climbs cliffs with long, poison-tipped claws and is the only Pokémon that can learn Dire Claw. Hisuian Sneasel evolves into it when levelled up during the day holding a Razor Claw.
description.tagline: A lone, poison-clawed climber of Hisui's frozen cliffs

Level up, during the day, holding Razor Claw

note.text: Only Hisuian Sneasel becomes Sneasler, levelled up during the day holding a Razor Claw; Sneasel from anywhere else becomes Weavile at night instead.
